tapes.title: the edge of the world
tapes.what: Wib and Wob, two three-legged figures, walk east through a blocky world whose ground breaks into holes and stacks while they sing walk to the edge of the world with me.

tapes.title: all six sides
tapes.what: In a blue DOS block editor a flat side-view world has been extruded into 3D and turns; Wib and Wob are boxes now too and sing I love your sides, all six.

tapes.title: one floppy disk
tapes.what: A DOS zip program packs Wib, Wob and their creatures onto one floppy disk: Wib refuses to squash, then the creatures go in one by one as line drawings.

tapes.title: scramble's clock
tapes.what: On a green DOS desktop Wib and Wob run program after program while Scramble the cat, a resident program with a clock in the corner, pops up uninvited.

tapes.title: the night set
tapes.what: Two creatures DJ off a shelf of floppy disks; each disk they load opens a different place from their world for a moment, while Scramble keeps watch from the corner.

tapes.title: doctor wobso
tapes.what: A talking-doctor program on a blue DOS screen tries to hold the word BRRLZZT as Wib chants it letter by letter, until it breaks with a parity error and the letters light up.

tapes.title: the game box
tapes.what: The title screen of a 1992 PC game, WIBWOB WORLD ROGUE in dripping letters, with Wib and Wob standing by the castle under a starry sky.

tapes.title: the island
tapes.what: A white line drawing of an island with a castle tower is drawn shape by shape on black, line after line, until it is whole.

tapes.title: the hall of mirrors
tapes.what: Rows of mirrored copies of Wib, Wob and Scramble dance out of step in a dark hall, then every copy moves together for one moment.

tapes.title: floor minus three
tapes.what: Seen through a round porthole, Wib and Wob go down a 3D stairwell of bricks that all say no, singing go down anyway and the walls are made of no.

tapes.title: the far thump
tapes.what: Wib and Wob cross a blocky snowy forest at night towards a party they can hear, and reach the castle door at sunrise singing dance till the sun.

tapes.title: the tower walks
tapes.what: The Wib&Wob castle tower, the one on every closing card, walks across the window: it grows long owl legs, stands up and creeps about, crouching and darting, then folds its legs and sits down again.
